title: Explicit Gaussian polynomial-threshold pseudorandom generator with polynomial dependence on degree

standard_prerequisites.name: Gaussian Hermite orthogonality/hypercontractivity [13], imported Kane relative anticoncentration [9] and generator discretization [7], elementary moment and Taylor bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported Theorems12/Lemma18 and Gaussian basis/noise facts retained. All source-local vector anticoncentration, slow-growth, Hermite restrictions, deviation moments, mollifier and main hybrid-step proofs retained; cited background not recursively reproved.

core_obligations: Prove the full Hermite-basis restriction and derivative expansions needed for non-multilinear Gaussian polynomials.
Lift scalar relative anticoncentration to vectors and establish slow growth of all derivative orders.
Lower-sandwich the threshold function using the author mollifier and reduce PRG correctness to a hybrid replacement step.
Prove both poorly-behaved and well-behaved derivative cases, including the full Taylor remainder analysis under moment matching, then derive the stated seed bound.
difficulty_reason: Non-routine Hermite/Taylor expansions and vector relative anticoncentration control derivative growth. A derivative-based mollifier supports a two-case moment-matching hybrid argument with a full multivariate truncation-error analysis, yielding the explicit seed bound. These structural/support results are bundled with one main PRG conclusion.
